skill.summary: Query Umami Cloud (v2) analytics data via API using an environment-provided API key. Use when agents need website traffic, pages, events, sessions, realtime, reports, or attribution data for analysis, planning, experiments, or monitoring. Includes read-only API querying patterns, endpoint selection guidance, and reusable scripts for flexible endpoint + time-range requests.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial publish: read-only Umami API querying skill with cloud/self-hosted support, endpoint docs, and improved defaults/hints for metrics, reports, and cloud user endpoint restrictions.
